title: Salaño, Magtubo rule PUMA Philippine Half Marathon Series Manila leg
summary: National team members Richard Salaño and Edna Magtubo emerged victorious in the Manila leg of the PUMA Philippine Half Marathon Series 2026 at the SM Mall of Asia Complex on Sunday.
